source: public sample VIDEO, not live IMX219

node.name: Sample video - virtual crosswalk
node.tagline: the crosswalk that watches out for you

rules.name: Beacon off
rules.when: no condition of B1/B2 holds (and the 1.5 s hold time has expired)
rules.it: Nessuna condizione B1/B2 attiva (trascorsi 1.5 s): lampeggiante spento.

rules.name: Caution - people at the crossing
rules.when: a pedestrian, cyclist or e-scooter is ON the crosswalk, or WAITING at / WALKING UP TO the curb, AND a vehicle is approaching with time-to-arrival < 6 s
rules.then: amber beacon slow blink + walking icon on the LED matrix, held 1.5 s after the condition ends
rules.it: Se un pedone/ciclista è sulle strisce, in attesa o in avvicinamento al marciapiede E un veicolo arriva entro 6 s: lampeggiante giallo lento + icona pedone, mantenuto per 1.5 s.

rules.name: Danger - imminent conflict
rules.when: a vehicle is on a collision course with a person on the carriageway: time-to-collision <= 2 s AND the vehicle would need > 3 m/s2 braking to stop (DRAC)
rules.then: beacon turns RED, fast blink + buzzer + warning icon (overrides B1)
rules.it: Se un veicolo è in rotta di collisione con una persona in carreggiata (TTC ≤ 2 s e frenata necessaria > 3 m/s²): lampeggiante ROSSO rapido + cicalino + icona di pericolo.

rules.name: Rest on vehicle green
rules.then: vehicles GREEN, pedestrians RED (no useless stops for traffic)
rules.it: Nessuno in attesa: verde ai veicoli, rosso ai pedoni.

rules.name: Pedestrian call (by camera or button)
rules.when: someone waits at a curb for >= 0.8 s (or presses the button) AND vehicles have had green for >= 8 s AND no vehicle is about to cross (< 3 s away) - or vehicle green reached 40 s
rules.then: vehicles YELLOW 3 s -> ALL RED 1.5 s -> pedestrians GREEN
rules.it: Persona in attesa ≥ 0.8 s (o pulsante) e verde veicoli da ≥ 8 s senza veicoli a meno di 3 s (o verde veicoli ≥ 40 s): giallo 3 s, tutto rosso 1.5 s, verde pedoni.

rules.name: Walk phase
rules.when: pedestrian green has lasted >= 5 s and nobody else is waiting - or it reached 20 s
rules.it: Verde pedoni per almeno 5 s, prolungato finché arrivano altre persone (max 20 s), poi lampeggiante di sgombero.

rules.name: Clearance + Green Man+ extension
rules.when: clearance lasts L / 1.2 m/s = 10.0 s; if someone is still on the crosswalk, it is extended by their measured time to reach the curb (max +8 s)
rules.then: pedestrians FLASHING until everyone is off the crosswalk, then ALL RED
rules.it: Sgombero di 10.0 s (L / 1.2 m/s), prolungato di quanto serve a chi è ancora sulle strisce (max +8 s): nessuno resta in mezzo alla strada.

rules.name: Return to traffic
rules.when: all red has lasted >= 1.5 s AND the crosswalk is empty (or 6 s have passed)
rules.it: Tutto rosso ≥ 1.5 s e strisce libere (o 6 s): verde ai veicoli.

rules.name: Fixed-time baseline
rules.when: signal mode = fixed (used only to compare against the adaptive rules)
rules.then: fixed cycle: vehicles green 20 s, yellow, all red, pedestrians green, clearance, all red
rules.it: Modalità a tempo fisso (solo come confronto): ciclo fisso indipendente da chi c'è.

rules.name: Fail-safe
rules.when: the STM32 receives no heartbeat from the vision side for 2 s (crash, reboot, cable)
rules.then: vehicle lamp FLASHING AMBER, pedestrian lamps off, '!' on the LED matrix - like a real controller fault
rules.it: Se il microcontrollore non riceve segnali dalla parte di visione per 2 s: giallo lampeggiante, pedonali spente, '!' sulla matrice LED.
